pageProps.title: The Metamorphosis
pageProps.review: Franz Kafka's The Metamorphosis depicts the process of a human who turns into an insect and loses social function being neglected by family, illustrating the value of existence and heartless alienation that are still valid in modern society.
pageProps.content:
## Review He lived faithfully supporting his family as the head of the household, but as soon as he turns into a monster, the family members gradually reject and loathe him. As time passes, he remains locked in his room, gradually weakening, and faces a death that no one grieves. The family prepares for a new beginning with relief as soon as he dies.
It depicts the deletion of existence experienced by a human when they lose social function. Although it was published over a century ago, the theme contained in this work still deeply resonates in modern society.
```When you become a bug, how quickly will the world abandon you?```
